notes: ACCESS: Akamai WAF blocks direct/curl_cffi (403 on all profiles: chrome124/131/120/safari17_0) and plain Playwright (net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / timeout on both http2-disabled and enabled attempts) to any nykaafashion.com page beyond robots.txt. robots.txt (curl_cffi chrome124, HTTP 200) has generic 'User-agent: *' / 'Allow: /' with no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow (only /ndsxadm/, /catalogsearch/, /widget-listing/, /all-reviews, /gateway-api/, /rest/appapi/V2/ blocked). AAAA record exists (2405:200:1630:1600::b855:dced) but IPv6 curl also returned 403 -- Akamai blocks on TLS/JS fingerprint, not IP family. translate.goog (the prior Home-Decor pass's working route) is banned per current brief, so used Claude-in-Chrome as the compliant last-resort tier, which reached the site with a real browser session (no challenge). ABSENCE CHECK FOR PET CARE: (1) Top nav has exactly 5 verticals -- Women (/women/c/6557), Men (/men/c/6823), Kids (/kids/c/6266), Home (/home/c/8528), All Brands -- no Pets/Pet Care vertical anywhere in site navigation. (2) Extracted the site's own __PRELOADED_STATE__ category-filter tree from the main Home department listing (https://www.nykaafashion.com/home/c/8528) -- this is the SAME live-DB-backed productCount facet tree the prior Home-Decor pass used and fully enumerated (Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Bedding, Bath, Storage, Home Essentials, Appliances). Regex-scanned all 1246 distinct category names in that tree for /pet/i -- zero genuine matches; only false positives were 'Carpet'-containing names (Rugs & Carpets, Carpet Brush, CARPET DECORE, Sapana Carpet-Mats). No 'Pet'/'Pets'/'Pet Care' node exists anywhere in the Home vertical's full category tree. (3) Site search (on-site search box, q=pet) returned 145 scattered SKUs with no dedicated Pet Care PLP/category: recycled-PET-material bags/sleeves (material name collision, not pet-related), kids' animal-themed soft toys, dog/cat-print charms and rakhis (human jewellery/accessories), a dhurrie themed 'Pet' by brand name, and a handful of genuine pet products (Playbox Pet Grooming Set, Kuber Industries pet nursing bottles, Guess pet-carrier-style bag, Hopop pet/child safety gate) scattered individually across Kids/Home/Women/Accessories categories with no organizing Pet Care branch -- this is scattered-SKU noise, not proof of a hidden category, and confirms rather than contradicts the absence finding from (1) and (2). CONCLUSION: Nykaa Fashion (nykaafashion.com) has no Pet Care category/vertical. rows is empty by design, not an extraction failure.
